text: Stav Kipper All good! :) Yes you can definitely do the process without marriage (although it is much faster if you are married, so if that is an option you are considering, I would recommend doing it before you apply). You should apply when your partner is back home in Thailand - she will need to get a documents from there. You can see a step-by-step guide on our website here: https://aic.org.il/partner-visa-in-israel-step-by-step-guide-to-your-first-visa/
